correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives the three partial derivatives; the affine critical locus reduces to G(y)=y^16(y+1)^5-1, and the restriction of F has coprime remainder R(y)=-y^18+y^12-y^4-y^3, with no singularities at infinity. Hence C is smooth of genus ten. Exact complete enumerations of F_{3^m}, m=1..10, use the polynomial-gcd root-count formula; direct pair enumeration cross-checks m<=5. Newton identities and the genus-ten Weil functional equation give all 21 Weil coefficients. Rabin irreducibility checks modulo 23 prove irreducibility over Q; c10 nonzero modulo three proves ordinarity.

value.rationale: This is the unique smooth member in the small characteristic-three instance of a motivated degree-q+3 plane-filling pencil, at the first degree above the Tallini minimal family. Its complete Weil polynomial determines rational points over every finite extension and its irreducibility identifies a nontrivial simple, ordinary dimension-ten Jacobian. Neither the curve’s plane-filling property nor its already-known ordinarity predicts the exact polynomial or simplicity; this is a natural complete arithmetic invariant rather than an arbitrary coefficient experiment.
